title: A Windows-only merge-tool defect passes the batch PR run and lands red on main
why: On a PR, checks-windows-merge runs only the 18 @windows_slice tests and skips shards 2-5 (checks.yml 1587-1625, decision ci-job-caps cap-75 stopgap). The full Windows merge suite runs only on push to main. Batch 113 passed its PR run and turned main red (ExpressPath).
source: coordinator 21:03 CST Nov 12; lane session_013NEJKzMndrATd5V4pyEZoB, fix #3052
note: Settled by R62 part 3 (owner 15:55 CST Nov 12, store entry r62): "the Windows full guard and merge shards move into the batch PR run". That is the full fix: each suite runs once per batch, on the batch PR. No owner item. The work is in step ci-linux-windows-once (lane session_013NEJL3q82Z6A8yHbNvQ5Nf), part 3. Until part 3 lands, the coordinator's option a (add the ExpressPath tests and any shell-out path test to @windows_slice) is a bandaid. It changes no verdict that R62 has not already ordered, so it may ride with fix #3052. Closes when part 3 merges. Parent: main-red-windows-ci-scope. Coordinator pick 21:05 CST Nov 12 (process-only): no bandaid in #3052; it stays the narrow fix and its review holds. R62 part 3 lands through ci-linux-windows-once.
